title: Password-reset service level collapsed after a "copy" routing change
scenario: After a Sunday routing-profile consolidation described as a straight copy of existing settings, LFG's PasswordReset service level dropped from about 86% to 70% and abandons tripled, while other queues improved. Supervisors see agents Available while callers wait. Find the cause in the contact records, metrics and profile exports, and fix it forward.
task: Trace the regression through metrics, contact-record queue times and the real-time snapshot
Explain the routing-profile mechanism behind it and why the smoke test passed
Fix config/ without rolling back the consolidation; verify with make replay
Rule out the training-day red herring with numbers
acceptance: Replay: PasswordReset >= 82% with low abandon and ASA; other queues on target
Consolidation kept; profiles valid; environment unchanged
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md match the injected fault
